$note: Three MCP servers under Shape C — ALL invoked via LOCAL workspace paths (no auto-install `npx`, no registry fetch). `attest` and `attest-policy-dev` run the local build output at `./packages/attest-mcp/dist/cli.js` (produced by `npm --workspace packages/attest-mcp run build`); `attest-conductor` is served by the Cursor-published `@cursor/bdk` dev dependency (install locally; do not fetch at runtime). See .cursor/README.md "Shape-C policy mode flip" for how to flip to ENFORCE and "Local install" for how to prepare the workspace.

attest.$comment: Primary attest-mcp server. Under Shape C this is both the validator surface (unchanged) and the policy host (new in Shape C: evaluate_shell_policy, evaluate_write_policy, evaluate_mcp_policy, list_fences, request_approval, invoke_expert, pre_dispatch_check). LOCAL-ONLY invocation: runs the workspace build output directly; a missing dist/ is a loud error (run `npm --workspace packages/attest-mcp run build`). Default policy mode is the server's own default (ENFORCE once the policy bundle lands); override per-user by setting ATTEST_POLICY_MODE in the user's shell env.

attest-conductor.$comment: Local-dev invocation: served out of packages/attest-conductor via the Cursor-published `cursor-bdk` bin (`@cursor/bdk` must be a workspace devDependency — install locally, do NOT fetch at runtime). For deployed Cursor installs, swap this stanza for { "url": "https://<your-conductor-host>/v1/mcp", "type": "http" } pointing at the deployed BDK agent (BDK deployments expose /<slug>/v1/mcp automatically via `npx @cursor/bdk deploy`). This package is NEVER published to npm; it lives only in this workspace.

attest-policy-dev.$comment: Shape-C local-dev policy engine. Same local build as `attest`, pinned to ATTEST_POLICY_MODE=LOG_ONLY so the editor-side chief (sdlc-lead) can test policies without blocking the user. Decisions get written through to `docs/work/policy-decisions.jsonl` by the policy hooks. Flip to ENFORCE (either here or in the `attest` entry) when the policy bundle is trusted; see .cursor/README.md.
